ctor.rationale: `base(2, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (Juggernaut.cs:18-21) == cost 2 / POWER / RARE / SELF. It does NOT override GainsBlock -- the Block hover tip (Juggernaut.cs:14) is explanatory, the card gains no block itself -- and the sim leaves `gains_block` False.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new PowerVar<JuggernautPower>(6m)` (Juggernaut.cs:16) == `_power_amount = 6`, stored in the `_power_amount` slot `magic_number` reads -- the correct storage, contrast card/feel_no_pain, which put the same shape of number in `_block`.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<JuggernautPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["JuggernautPower"].BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (Juggernaut.cs:26) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, JuggernautPower, self._power_amount, applier=ctx.player)`. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (25). JuggernautPower's per-block-gain damage is the power stream's, and card/evil_eye's two SEPARATE block gains are what make it fire twice on both sides.
